title: Ultrasound: breast lesions and the fetal head
description: Nine ultrasound images with true pixel size. Six breast ultrasound images from Breast-Lesions-USG, each lesion outlined by a radiologist experienced in breast ultrasound: two biopsy-proven invasive carcinomas, two biopsy-proven fibroadenomas and two simple cysts confirmed on follow-up. Three fetal head images on the standard plane from HC18 with the sonographer's head-circumference ellipse. Images are the datasets' cropped 8-bit PNGs; no orientation tag.

referenceTargets.label: Breast mass: invasive carcinoma of no special type, biopsy-proven (radiologist outline)

provenanceDetail.method: Freehand outline of the lesion by a radiologist experienced in breast ultrasound, who also gave the BI-RADS descriptors (TCIA collection description; Pawłowska et al. 2024); case007_tumor.png traced into image_px [col, row].
provenanceDetail.note: BI-RADS 5; shape irregular; margin not circumscribed - spiculated&indistinct; echogenicity hypoechoic; posterior features shadowing; confirmed by biopsy; diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST).

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the lesion is outlined; skin, glandular tissue and other lesions are not referenced.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST) (confirmed by biopsy): irregular, margin not circumscribed - spiculated&indistinct, posterior features shadowing.

referenceTargets.teachingNote: The sonographer's ellipse around the outer skull; the head circumference on this image is 87 mm.
